title: This Student Killed Hundreds Of People Without Touching Them . . .

segments.say: This student killed *hundreds* of people, and he never touched a single one.
Jack was the smartest kid in Japan, and the most *bored*.
Then one day, a black *notebook* fell from the sky.

segments.text: The human whose name is written in this notebook shall die.

segments.say: He thought it was a *prank*. So he tested it on a man holding kids hostage.
Forty seconds later, the man dropped *dead*.

segments.text: The suspect has been found dead inside.

segments.say: A *heart attack*. Just like the notebook said.
To be sure, he wrote down a thug attacking a girl, and this time, he wrote how he dies.

segments.text: That settles it. The Death Note. It's for real!

segments.say: Five days later, his notebook was full of *names*.
Then the real owner showed up. A *death god*.
Jack asked him why he dropped it.

segments.text: I did it because I was bored.

segments.say: But Jack wasn't scared at all. He had a much bigger *plan*.

segments.text: I will become the god of this new world.

segments.say: But the world's greatest *detective* was already coming for him.
